title: See BK Technologies at IACP 2022 in Dallas, October 15-18
summary: Read BK Technologies information about See BK Technologies at IACP 2022 in Dallas, October 15-18.
body_markdown:
BK Technologies is joining IACP for its annual conference and expo October 15 – 18 in Dallas, Texas.


Come visit booth **#2424** in the Kay Bailey Hutchison Convention Center, where public safety professionals can learn about our portable and mobile radio devices, as well as BK’s new SaaS software,[InteropONE](https://www.interopone.com/) .


See the official[BKR 9000](https://www.bktechnologies.com/product/bkr-9000-portable-radio/) , BK Technologies’ multi-band P25 portable radio, designed with FIPS 140-2 Level 3 encryption capability. The BKR 9000 also introduces our industry-leading, unrivaled 5-year standard warranty.


**Attendees can also enter our raffle at the event to win a TV!**


For more information about the conference, visit[www.theiacpconference.org](https://www.theiacpconference.org/)
